svg.title: Responders: selank vs phenazepam
svg.desc: Responders at day 14: selank 5 of 30 (17%), phenazepam 7 of 30 (23%). Day 21, one week after stopping: 17 (57%) vs 9 (30%). CGI-I marked improvement at day 14: 5 (17%) vs 14 (47%).
